notes.content:

notes.title: Seraph updated: THE BIG 1.0 (Patch notes)
notes.content:
Here we are, everyone. The game finally launches officially on PC tomorrow, but I wanted to get this patch out to you guys ahead of time in-case we catch some final little issues. 

Thank you all for sticking with us and making Early Access the fun, rewarding and productive experience it really should be. You put your faith in us enough to buy an unfinished game and by doing so have given us what we needed in order to make Seraph the 90%+ recommended game we have today. 

Here are the Seraph V1.0 


[h1]Seraph V1.0[/h1]
[*]Doubled the chance of Story Log terminals appearing in levels. 
[*]Reduced the maximum size of levels in Treasure hunter daily challenges by 33%
[*]Increased duration of Double damage, double XP and armour orbs by 100% to 2 minutes. 
[*]We now trigger a short period of invincibility when the Ethereal Barrier (shield Blessing) goes down, preventing you from taking damage from AoE attacks that stick around, such as the Frost Ring or Fire Pillar. 
[*]Fixed a bug where icons would appear as <sprite=action1> when playing with a keyboard.
[*]Fixed a bug where new players may not have been directed to the Oaths screen for the first time.
[*]Should have finally fixed an issue where the player is given the message "game save corrupted" the very first time they play the game.
[*]Fixed a bug where Epic and Supreme shards were seen as "Crafting component A" when viewed in the Transmutation menu. 
[*]Reset some sounds to prevent them from looping when using Retry option to quickly repeat a daily challenge.
[*]Now completely reset the enemies for daily challenges. You cheesers! :D
[*] Added "v1.0" graphic to the first menu of the game. Players will be able to see new patch info next to this graphic for all future patches. 
[*]Released game.

notes.title: Seraph updated: Patch notes for V0.39
notes.content:

[*]Enemies no longer 'moonwalk' after they've killed you.
[*]Fixed some issues in the tutorial that could break progression.
[*]Fixed a bug where the audio on Comet would not play the first time you used it in a level.
[*]Fixed a bug whereby if a level loaded TOO FAST it may not ever load!

notes.title: Seraph updated: Patch notes for V0.37
notes.content:
Bug fixes and balance tweaks ahoy! 

However, we're still on the look-out for a nasty bug which prevents levels from loading in Normal or Survival mode (if a level hasn't loaded within 30-45 seconds, you have this bug). 

If you get this bug, PLEASE email us your game save file and the Output.log file BEFORE restarting the game (the output log is wiped each time the game is started). We can then isolate which file is not being loaded properly and fix it immediately. 

Please send us your 'output_log' file. You'll find it inside: 

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Seraph\Seraph_Data

Then, send it to support@dreadbit.com.

[*]Enemies spawn earlier on in ambush rooms (no more 10-15 seconds where nothing happens at the start!). 
[*]Reduced amount healed by Critical Healing from 50% to 30%.
[*]Increased penetration damage boost of Piercing Light from 50/60/70/80/100% to 100/110/120/130/150%

[*]Reduced the Silence area radius on the Void from 7m to 5m.
[*]Changed the graphic for when enemies are protected by being close to Dark Elites for clarity.

notes.title: Seraph updated: Patch notes for V0.15
notes.content:
Today's a big one for endgame players; damage is. We've also added 3 new Blessings and 2 Miracle upgrades. Exciting!

This patch won't be live until around 8am GMT, but we're posting this now. 

Read on for the full list of changes and bug fixes. 

[h1]Seraph V0.15[/h1]
[list][*]Trading cards enabled!
[*]Improved the Screen-size options menu with better support for multi-monitor setups.
[*]New Miracle: Orb II and III now available.
[*]New Miracle: Repel II and III now available.
[*]New Blessing: Critical Heal - Critical strikes will heal Seraph for 50% of the damage caused. 30 second cooldown.
[*]New Blessing: Sacred Projectiles - All weapon attacks burn enemies for 2% of their maximum Health as Holy damage over 3 seconds. This does not stack, but is refreshed with new damage.
[*]New Blessing: Deadly Grace - All damage is boosted by 15% for 1 second following a Blink.
[*]Altered Blessing: Reduced the heal on Healing Exorcism from 5-10% down to 3-7%.
[*]Altered Blessing: Reduced the Soul Stealer Oath from maximum 5% of damage into health down to 2.5% of damage into health. We want this Oath to provide a very gradual heal, rather than sending the player's health yo-yoing up and down.  
[*]Wording of "perfection" challenge modifier altered to better explain what's going on. "Score bonus points depending on how little damage Seraph takes during the Challenge". It is no longer how much health you have at the [i]end[/i] of the challenge.
[*]Boosted the amount of shards you recieve from daily challenge rewards. Buffed the reward for being in the top 50% to Uncommon shards. 
[*]Max damage of all enemy attacks at 10.0 and has been increased to 200, up from 100. This sharp increase only occurs at 7.0 and above. Damage prior to 7.0 is increased only slightly.
[*]Damage of all Daemon Lieutenant "special powers" has been boosted, in line with the changes above.
[*]Herald given a maximum HP boost from 7,000 > 8,000
[*]Herald's reflect bullet power extended in duration from 3 > 3.5 seconds, the speed of the reflected bullets upped from 20% at all difficulties to now scale between 20% and 80% of bullet speed (watch out, railgun users!). 
[*]Final boss given a maximum HP boost from a horribly low 6,000 (oops!) > 9,000
[*]Final boss now snipes with 2 shots in his 1st phase and 4 in its 3rd phase (final boss is still far from complete - keep meaning to get to it). 
[*]Reduced the maximum lifetime of maestro's homing orbs from 6 seconds down to 5 seconds. 
[*]Fixed a bug where the Thrall would never drop a Hooked Digit from the normal sized Daemons.

notes.title: Seraph development roadmap from Early Access to full launch
notes.content:
[img=http://41.media.tumblr.com/d791e0358614aea51508b93060793b42/tumblr_inline_o4srgq2Inm1szhksi_1280.jpg]

Hello gamers, 

The following information is a roadmap for Seraph, leading from our Early Access launch all the way up to the final, complete version of the game. I'm going to explain what's currently included in the game first, before expanding into what we plan to add to the game over the coming months. 

One of the most important parts of Early Access is not just what you're getting now, but what will be available to you in the upcoming content patches. Read on below to get a better idea of where Seraph is at and where it's headed!

I'd advise all Early Access participants who wish to provide feedback or suggestions for the game to have a quick scan of this list to see if your thoughts are already covered. If not, then feel free to create a post on the discussion boards.

[img=http://40.media.tumblr.com/26a9cbbe4f3a88563c329f44f2f452e6/tumblr_inline_o4srr3pif41szhksi_1280.jpg]

[b][h1]Seraph version 0.1:[/h1][/b]
We launch version 0.1 on Tuesday 26th April 2016. It is a fairly complete alpha version of the game and features, which I'll briefly list below. This list is not exhaustitive (because that would take thousands of words!), but it should give you a pretty good idea of what to expect when you buy and play Seraph v0.1.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Ultra responsive acrobatic platforming controls. Effortlessly navigate the levels with wall hangs, double-jumps and the rapid 'Blink' dash move.
[*]Automatic aiming. Seraph will pick and aim at targets for the player (often 2 targets at once), allowing them freedom to focus on keeping bursts of gunfire short and accurate, skilfully evading enemy attacks and positioning in combat.
[*]Larger 'Elite' enemies that can be weakened with gun-fire but must be executed with a close range 'Smite' attack. Players must close the gap and enter the fray to completely destroy these enemies and bosses. 
[*]Collect XP Motes and level up. 
[/list]

[b]Game modes[/b]
[list]
[*]Standard story mode campaign. Randomly constructed levels, with random enemy types, weapon lockers and power-ups. All aspects of the game feed off the player's current difficulty and skill level.
[*]Twitch mode. Viewers can vote to be #good or #evil, modifying the upcoming level for the streamer! Top banter ensues! 
[*]Speed-run mode. The game is no longer random, but is generated by a visible seed code. Speed-runners can share their favourite campaign seeds and compete for the best times. 
[*]2 Daily challenge modes (Survival and daemon hunt). Randomly generated level layout and challenge that is then shared with all players worldwide. Steam leader-board integration. 
[/list]

[b]Levels and enemies[/b]
[list]
[*]All 26 campaign levels across 5 visual themes. 
[*]1 unique music track per level, with an additional music track on the main menu and game front-end. 
[*]6 daemon enemy types, with 4 "flavour" variants that mix up their attacks, abilities and stats. These enemies also come in 3 classes: normal, elite and level boss. 
[*]2 proper boss enemies. The first of which is fairly complete, but the second requires proper feedback.   
[*]2 level objective types: Hunt the Lieutenant of Terminus (end of level boss with random powers and type) and destroy the Fountains of Terminus (destroy multiple objects that spawn daemon enemies). 
[/list]

[b]Weapons, pick-ups, Miracles and Blessings[/b]
[list]
[*]7 individual weapon types with multiple unlockable upgraded versions for each. 
[*]6 passive Blessing types, chosen when a player levels up. 
[*]3 Miracles: Smite, Orb and Repel. 
[*]7 protective Ward types, with multiple unlockable upgraded versions for each.
[/list]

[b]Crafting, Oath skill-tree and longevity[/b] 
[list]
[*]Transmutation crafting system, whereby players collect daemonic body parts from fallen enemies and convert them into new weapons, Wards and Miracles.
[*]Oath "skill-tree" system, where the strength of every skill is determined by the rarity of the Shard crystal you assign to it. 
[*]On-screen dynamic difficulty system that matches player skill level and always offers a challenge. Higher difficulties mean more Shard and crafting component drops. 
[/list]

[img=http://41.media.tumblr.com/0b60f9ebbd35e7f93bcc78a3797740bf/tumblr_inline_o4sq2qivaU1szhksi_1280.jpg]

[b][h1]Future planned updates to Seraph:[/h1][/b]
So what comes next? With version 0.1, we simply aimed to have [i]something[/i] of every feature. This is what's known as an Alpha version of the game. Over the coming months we plan to expand the content in the game while we head towards our Beta version.

[b]Miracles[/b] 
We currently have only 3 of our planned 9 Miracles implemented in-game. We wish to expand this list with the following Seraph powers: 
[list]
[*]Cripple - Attaches a holy link to the closest 3 enemies within 4 units for 2.5 seconds, slowing their movement and attack speed by 30%. If the link is not broken during this time (by moving too far away), then the chains explode, damaging the enemy for 200 holy damage.
[*]Comet - Seraph launches herself vertically towards the ground like a holy comet. When she strikes a surface, she deals 100 damage + 50 damage per unit that she travelled vertically to those around her.
[*]Execution - Strikes the closest targeted enemy for 10% of their maximum health as holy damage. If this effect reduces the enemy’s health bar to zero, Seraph is healed by 25% of her maximum health.
[*]Lightwell - The Angel summons down a thin pillar of light down directly onto her for 5 seconds (the light well stays where it is when seraph moves away).. All enemies that pass through are struck by this pillar and receive 200 holy damage.
[*]Exorcism - Launches a fast moving divine projectile in a straight at seraph’s target enemy. The first enemy to be struck will be damaged for 50 and “marked” for 6 seconds, taking 20% increased damage for that period. If the enemy’s health bar is reduced to zero within these 6 seconds, the enemy is automatically 'Smited'.
[*]Barrier - Activating this ability creates a bubble at Seraph’s position that lasts for 4 seconds. Seraph can leave the bubble. Enemy projectiles are destroyed when they touch the surface of the bubble, but attacks that originate inside the bubble still hurt Seraph. Enemies that pass into the bubble have their movement slowed by 25%.
[/list]

[b]Blessings[/b]
Blessings are ranked up each time a player reaches a new level. Here are the Blessings we aim to implement in addition to the 6 that are already in-game. 
[list]
[*]There’s a 10% chance that weapon attacks will explode on contact with enemies, dealing 50-100% of the attacks’ damage as holy to enemies within 2m.
[*]Weapon damage is boosted by 15-30% for 1 second after performing Blink.
[*]The first shooting attack on any enemy is guaranteed to be a critical strike. 
[*]Seraph reflects 200% of the damage she sustains back at her attacker. 
Critical strike chance is boosted by 10% when Seraph is in the air or clinging to walls. 
[*]Every 10 seconds, an enemy is marked for death. That enemy receives 25% more damage. Killing that enemy will spread the mark to another enemy within 3 units. 
[*]Seraph’s footsteps scorch the ground with holy light that lasts for 1 second. Enemies that touch these patches of ground take 25 magical damage. 
[*]Seraph causes her bullets to burn enemies on contact. Enemies that are struck by any weapon attack burn for 5% of their maximum health per second for 3 seconds. This effect does not stack but is refreshed by new damage.  
[*]Any holy damage caused to an enemy will burn them for an additional 50% of that damage over 3 seconds. 
[*]Seraph increases the damage of her attacks by 1% for every 2% of her missing health (this includes the missing portion after resurrection). This damage is holy.
[*]Critical strikes heal Seraph for 10% of the damage caused. This can only occur once every 10 seconds.
[*]Seraph creates a shield that will prevent 100% damage from one attack. This effect does not stack. 60 second cool-down.
[*]Moving around the level builds holy charge, that is expended as a large explosion when a weapon attack successfully strikes a target. Charge is built to a maximum of 50-100 holy damage. 
[*]Seraph’s weapon attacks slow their target by 20%, reducing their movement speed. 
[*]Seraph’s damage is increased against all targets within 3 units of her. 
[*]Enemies explode on death, causing 10% of it’s max health as damage to those within 3 units. 
[*]The longer Seraph is in contact with the floor, the more damage she causes. Her damage increases by 5% per 0.5 seconds and caps out at 50% increased damage. Jumping, falling off a ledge etc. at all removes this buff. 
[*]Bullets that penetrate an enemy cause 50% more damage to the next enemy to be struck by it. 
[*]Increases the effectiveness of all wards by 100%. 
[*]Seraph gains increased movement speed for 3 seconds after successfully Smiting an enemy. 
[/list]

[b]Boss powers[/b] 
Adding more unique unholy attack powers to the bosses in the game. We currently have 3 but plan to have 7-9 in total.

[b]Crafting, Oath skill-tree and front-end menus[/b] 
[list]
[*]Replacing some of the weaker Oaths from the Oath system with better ones.
[*]New Transmutation crafting recipes for additional ranks of Miracle.   
[*]Adding loot rewards that are given to Daily challenge participants, based on their rank at the end of each day. 
[*]Create a 'Codex' which records all story logs that have been found, all enemy type descriptions, weapon info and other such information that they players will encounter during their gameplay. Players can then review this information at their leisure. 
[/list]

[b]Additional Daily Challenge modes[/b] 
[list]
[*]Speed run - get to the exit of a level. 
Treasure hunter - Open all chests in the level as fast as possible. 
[*]Heraldry - Kill the mid-game boss as fast as possible. 
[*]Head hunter - Kill 10 elites as fast as possible. 
[*]Perfection - Gain as much XP as you can without taking any damage. 
[*]Cleansing - Find and kill all enemies in the level. 
[*]Score run - finish the level with the highest score possible
[*]Death clock - your health ticks down at 1 per second. Gain as much XP as you can before you die. 
[/list]

Daily challenge mode modifiers (randomly added to the challenge to give more variation each day. 
[list]
[*]Perfect - get extra score for how little damage you took. 
[*]Fleet - get extra score for how little you touched the ground. 
[*]Killing enemies with Miracles is worth double score. 
[*]Lose score every time you dash. 
[*]Gain score every time you open an item chest. 
[*]Gain score every time you smite 2 or more enemies at once. 
[/list]

[b]Localisation into more languages[/b] 
English, French, German, Spanish and Russian are planned. Russian may be trickier than the others due to special characters, but we'll do our best. 

[b]Music and audio[/b] 
Filling in the SFX gaps with new sounds and producing an additional 5 music tracks to reduce repetition.

[b]Twitch[/b] 
Adding a tonne of new buffs and de-buffs to Twitch mode, many of which will be included in the regular game as secret pick-ups. 

[b]Hardware[/b] 
Controller vibration!

[img=http://36.media.tumblr.com/d6e075aeddd4c2d2f505daf7a7bd531d/tumblr_inline_o4vnrylVws1szhksi_1280.jpg]
 
And that's it for now! We aim to finish the whole game within the next 2-3 months, depending on how Early Access works out. If we find ourselves lucky enough to have additional funds to spend, we will put this into additional features, enemy types, music and other such bonuses! 

We'll let you guys know immediately as and when we make the decision to add new features. 

Thanks for reading,

Daniel and the development team
